eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 3rd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Metaverse, and Cybersecurity (ICAMAC)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Power, Energy and Industry Applications; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.sponsors: Higher Colleges of Technology - Computer and Information Science Department ; Rochester Institute of Technology Dubai; Sakarya University; United Arab Emirates Section; United Arab Emirates Section E Chapter
eventDetail.scope: Aim: ICAMAC2026 aspires to unite diverse stakeholders-academics, scientists, experts, students, and industry representatives-to engage in the exchange and exploration of both theoretical concepts and practical insights. By fostering discussions, presentations, and networking opportunities, the conference aims to cultivate a rich knowledge-sharing environment. Scope: AI: Focus on AI in education, sustainability, healthcare, and robotics. Metaverse: Discuss Metaverse integration with AI, including virtual environments. Cybersecurity: Address challenges in securing AI and Metaverse technologies. Networking and Collaboration: Enhance professional networks and interdisciplinary collaborations. ICAMAC2026 aspires to drive innovation in these dynamic fields
